name: T-box transcription factor 3
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TBX3 encodes t-box transcription factor TBX3. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to ulnar-mammary syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Neuroendocrine tumor of breast; Invasive lobular carcinoma of breast. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
